compiler.evidence: Migration/jclToZBuilder/samples/BLDMORT.jcl compiles EPSMPMT with STEPLIB IGY.V6R1M0.SIGYCOMP (Enterprise COBOL 6.1) and no PARM: the program's CBL NUMPROC(MIG) compiles as the default NUMPROC(NOPFD) (oracle_assumptions.md C5)

calls.name: thirty-years
calls.why: a 30-year mortgage: Y, months = years * 12, the annuity formula in A200

calls.name: fifteen-years-in-months
calls.why: N: the months field is used as given (180)

calls.name: other-indicator
calls.why: any indicator other than 'Y' takes the months field

calls.name: maximum-principal
calls.why: exactly the static maximum 100000000.01: not greater, so valid

calls.name: high-rate
calls.why: a 99.999% rate over 360 months: (1+i)**n grows to about 1e12 in COMP-1

calls.name: principal-zero
calls.why: principal not > 0 -> indicator 1, A999 returns error text 1; the payment field is left as passed

calls.name: principal-negative
calls.why: a negative principal -> error 1 ('PRINCIPLE AMOUNT IS NEGATIVE')

calls.name: rate-zero
calls.why: a rate not > 0 -> indicator 3 ('NEGATIVE INTEREST RATE')

notes: IBM DBB MortgageApplication's monthly-payment calculator (CALLed by EPSCSMRT; its business logic). It carries CBL NUMPROC(MIG); the estate builds it with Enterprise COBOL 6.1, which no longer supports MIG and compiles the default NUMPROC(NOPFD) instead (IBM Migration Guide; oracle_assumptions.md C5, #4271). NUMPROC does not touch binary or floating-point items in any case, and EPSMPMT's zoned items are unsigned items it fills itself. EPSPDATA's inputs are binary (COMP), so each call gives them as field values (equivalence_call.arg_bytes). The payment goes through WS-CALC-INTEREST COMP-1. z/OS evaluates both COMPUTEs that name it in hexadecimal floating point (IBM Programming Guide, Appendix A); GnuCOBOL stores an IEEE float and evaluates in decimal truncated by ARITHMETIC-OSVS (599550.79 against an exact 599550.51 for maximum-principal). The det translator therefore refuses the float item by name and the case is not proven on purpose (oracle_assumptions.md C6, proof_sweep KNOWN_UNPROVEN). Its scenarios stay for a z/OS capture (#4050). A zero-month loan is left out on purpose: the COMPUTE divides by ((1+i)**0)-1 = 0 with no ON SIZE ERROR, an outcome that is compiler-dependent. A300-TRY2 (FUNCTION ANNUITY, a translation hole) is dead code: never PERFORMed (answer key).
